missing_pokemon: You don't seem to have any healthy Pokemon, sorry to do this, but you'll need to go back out the way you came and heal your Pokemon.
low_level_cap: I'm sorry to put you out like this, but your Pokemon are too low level to battle me. Please come back when your Pokemon are stronger.
over_level_cap: THIS IS A BUG, IF YOU SEE THIS MESSAGE, SCREENSHOT AND REPORT IT TO MIZU ON DISCORD. (over_level_cap gym_water_kamiya)
battle_start: My name is Kamiya, it's a pleasure to meet you! I hope you're ready for a battle!
battle_lost: That was very impressive, you deserve this medallion and the TM for Water Pulse. If you haven't already, make sure you go challenge the gym in Jewel of the Desert.
battle_won: I enjoyed myself thoroughly, thank you. Please come back when your Pokemon are stronger, and we can battle again!
on_cooldown: I am so sorry, but I need to recuperate before we can battle again. Please come back later.
is_busy: I'm in the middle of a battle, but I'll happily battle you when I'm done.
done_looser: There is nothing more either of us can get out of battling each other.
done_winner: I really think you should go train some more before we battle again, I don't think you are ready for another battle with me.
